answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to capital locked. In this architecture, an attacker seeking to spawn a gale of fake identities faces an economic canyon, as the cost to acquire sufficient staked tokens exceeds the potential gains from network corruption. By abandoning the ivory tower of abstract reputation, this model forces adversaries to commit verifiable financial value, effectively pricing out large-scale identity fabrication attempts.
